testcase.name: a stored order keeps only the colour fields, in the stored order, and the map draws them in it
a stored opacity is kept only for a layer with a slider, and a value outside 0 to 1 is refused, never clamped
stored visibility applies to the layers the sheet can switch, and a stored choice for any other layer is refused and reported
a colour field with no data is hidden in the state the map gets, whatever the stored choice, and nothing else changes
the colour fields list top of the draw order first, Move up and Move down step one place, and opacity multiplies through layerPaintFor
while a synthetic layer is visible the caption gains the synthetic credit once, and with none visible it does not
